experiences.title: Programme Intern
bullets: Designed a survey of 180 residents and analysed the responses in SPSS for the charity's housing report.
Ran twelve interviews with community members and wrote up the themes for the programme team.
Coordinated volunteers across three outreach sessions, matching each volunteer to a site.

experiences.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Coded 200 open-ended survey responses into a scheme the professor used in a published paper.
Built the Excel workbook that tracked interview scheduling and consent records for the study.
Wrote the literature summary that shaped the team's interview questions.

experiences.title: Volunteer coordinator
bullets: Led a group of fifteen volunteers running weekend activities for secondary students.
Handled two disagreements inside the volunteer group by talking to each person separately first.
Presented the year's activity report to the centre's management and the funding body.
